goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Claim: attached two-target Holds now evaluate edited boundaries against their stored source replacement. A valid 0 ms boundary retains both selected targets, commits, reloads, and preserves exact semantic/generated target coverage. An invalid 900 ms boundary disables submission, reports visible unavailability, leaves revision unchanged, and recovers when restored. Top failures—generated-track eligibility drift, silent invalid edits, and target loss across persistence—are directly covered in installed Chrome. Two sanitized receipts were byte-identical (SHA-256 dc4ef6e8a990f1fa40913d1c4d4ee4b2d2bf3fbf8ab18d127337c8649738d14f); diagnostics, privacy, protected files, typecheck, and build are clean.
